references.text: Misael and Elzaphan, the sons of Uzziel, are mentioned here when they were asked to carry the bodies of Nadab and Abihu out of the camp after they died in the Lord's presence.
Elzaphan, son of Uzziel, is named as head of the families of the Kohathites in the census of the Levites.
The descendants of Elzaphan are mentioned among the Levites whom David gathered to bring the ark of the Lord to Jerusalem.
The descendants of Elzaphan are mentioned among the Levites who consecrated themselves during King Hezekiah's religious reforms.
Complementary genealogical records for the sons of Uzziel showing the development of the Kohathites' role from the wilderness to the temple.
Expands the genealogy by confirming Micah as a son of Uzziel and introducing the line of Shamir.
